observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with white walls, a light wood floor, ceiling spotlights, a sheer white curtain, and a full-height mirror covering the right wall. A woman with dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a short black sleeveless dress with an asymmetric sheer hem, black leg-warmers and black heeled dance shoes, stands in the center with her back partly to the camera. Her mirror image is visible throughout on the right; it is a reflection of the same person, not a second dancer. The camera is fixed.
visible_changes: Frames 1-12: she holds a static pose with the right arm bent and raised beside her head (fingers spread) and the left arm extended back and down, torso angled toward the mirror; only small shifts of the raised hand occur.
Frames 13-16: the raised right arm lowers toward shoulder level and then drops to her side while her torso rotates so her back turns more squarely to the camera.
Frames 17-24: with arms down at her sides she continues rotating; her ponytail swings across her back, indicating a turn of head/torso, and the reflection shows her facing the mirror.
Frames 25-29: she settles into a wide stance, weight on the left leg, the right foot rotating to a pointed toe on the floor; the reflection shows one arm reaching horizontally.
Frames 30-41: the right arm lifts again into a fully extended upward reach angled toward the mirror/ceiling, and she holds this extended-arm pose with the right toe pointed through the last frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the initial raised-arm pose and what follows the final upward reach are not shown.
The intended dance phrase or music cue is unknown.
uncertain_details: Whether the hair swing comes from a head turn or a torso rotation is not fully resolvable.
The exact foot articulation (point vs. relevé) on the right leg is partly obscured by the angle.
Minor hand/finger adjustments during the held poses are hard to track frame-by-frame.
